title: Album release: Ringo Rama by Ringo Starr | 2003
content:
Ringo Rama, Ringo Starr’s 13th studio album, was released worldwide on 25 March 2003.

Released by the Koch label, the first 100,000 copies included a DVD with footage from the recording sessions. A deluxe CD edition contained three bonus tracks: ‘Blink’, ‘OK Ray’, and ‘I’m Home’.

Ringo Rama peaked at number 113 on the US Billboard 200.

Page last updated: 7 September 2021
